page_note: 该页为OECD《经济展望中期报告2025年3月》第17页，上部是Figure 9的两联柱状图（A. GDP level与B. Consumer price inflation），下方为注释、来源行及第22–24段正文。

heading.title: Further trade fragmentation would harm global growth prospects
heading.subtitle: Simulation of a rise of 10 percentage points in US tariffs on non-commodity imports from all countries and 10 percentage points higher tariffs on non-commodity imports from the United States by all countries

figures.source_line: Source: OECD calculations using the NiGEM global macroeconomic model and the OECD METRO model.

components.evidence: Panel A axis runs 0.00 down to -1.50; all nine bars hang below the 0.00 line
Panel A ticks 0.00 to -1.50 in 0.25 steps; Panel B ticks 0.0 to 1.0 in 0.1 steps
"A. GDP level" and "B. Consumer price inflation" set in bold above each plot
x ticks read "WLD OECD USA EA JPN CHN IND CAN MEX" in both panels
"%" sits above the 0.00 tick in A; "% pts" above the 1.0 tick in B
bare numeric ticks; scale given only by "%" and "% pts" beside the axis tops
horizontal rules at each tick in both plots, no vertical grid lines
"Note: Illustrative scenario of the impact of 10% US tariffs..." and "Source: OECD calculations..." below
two side-by-side bar panels A and B over the same nine country codes
each panel draws its category axis once; the same nine codes align under both plots

new_components.name: zero_baseline_at_axis_top
new_components.evidence: Panel A's 0.00 tick is the topmost gridline; bars are drawn downward from it
new_components.why_it_matters: 读数方向反转：柱长要从顶部0.00向下量，若按常规自底向上会得到正号或错误量级。

new_components.name: per_panel_unit_differs
new_components.evidence: Panel A labelled "%", Panel B labelled "% pts" above their axes
new_components.why_it_matters: 两联图单位不同，取值必须绑定所属面板，不能跨面板共用同一单位标注。

new_components.name: panel_specific_series_colour
new_components.evidence: Panel A bars are light blue, Panel B bars are purple, with no legend
new_components.why_it_matters: 颜色不编码系列而区分面板，读者只能靠面板标题定位，不能靠图例辨认。

difficulty_notes: 全部18根柱子都没有数值标签，只能靠网格线量。A面板网格间距0.25，而-0.28要求5%容差即±0.014，相当于格距的1/18；B面板网格间距0.1，0.17的5%容差为±0.0085，不到格距的1/10，甚至0.90与0.9网格线重合才好读。像-0.73（介于-0.50与-0.75之间）、-1.30（在-1.25网格线略下方）这类值必须做亚像素插值才能落进容差，因此读数本身是最硬的一环；标签方面每个值只需“面板名+国别代码”两个键，表格容易承载。
